_comment: BEACON project MCP servers (Claude Code format). Derived from GABBE agents/templates/core/MCP_CONFIG_TEMPLATE.json — a BEACON-relevant subset. Set the referenced env vars in .env (gitignored). Enable per-need; npx servers self-install on first run.

context7._description: Up-to-date SDK/library docs — prevents API hallucination (Next.js, MapLibre, Turf, Prisma, etc.). HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

sequential-thinking._description: Structured chain-of-thought before acting on complex SDLC/spec reasoning.

filesystem._description: RAG over the local project (specs, audit, agents kit).

brave-search._description: Authoritative web research — used to re-verify data-source availability/licensing (audit policy).

github._description: PR review, code search, issues — for S05+.

postgres-dev._description: Read-write dev Postgres (BEACON canonical store). Enable at S05 when the DB exists.

playwright._description: Browser automation for golden-path e2e tests + demo capture. Enable at S06.
